off_state_silence.detail: during the 33 s the unit was off, the vendor HID device produced no payload traffic in the capture

transition_32_48.detail: a capture was started 34 s before power-on and ran 340 s. Every one of the 76,382 type-0x20 reports was 48 bytes; not a single 32-byte report appeared.
transition_32_48.conclusion: the earlier single observation that the stream starts in a 32-byte form and switches near 45.8 s is NOT supported by this run; the steady 48-byte form was present from the first report, 50 ms after enumeration. The cause and the existence of the startup form remain UNKNOWN.

wire_evdev_correlation.summary: every control was correlated by timestamp, not by nearest frame. Trigger values agreed sample for sample, and button edges agreed to within one report interval (40 microseconds).
wire_evdev_correlation.resolves: the open discrepancy in which the input layer was thought to report a smooth trigger ramp while the wire looked binary. Both show the same coarse, quantised sequence: three rising samples in about 20 ms and two falling samples in about 16 ms, for a pull the operator performed over about two seconds.

trigger_quantisation.observation: a deliberately slow two-second pull is reported as a fast three-step rise in about 20 ms, then a 1.3 s hold at 1020, then a two-step fall in about 16 ms
trigger_quantisation.scale: 1020 appears to be full scale; the intermediate values are not evenly spaced

cross_validation.gip_decode: reproduced A, M1, M2, LT and RT exactly for the real pressed reports

defects_found.item: the GIP decoder reported stick axes as raw unsigned words with no signedness or scaling caveat, while the repository documents sticks as signed elsewhere
defects_found.action: the decoder now reports the raw words and the two's-complement reading plus an explicit note that neither signedness nor the scaling to the host axis range is established, because no stick sweep was correlated to evdev
defects_found.regression: tests/test_live_interactive_reports.py plus tests/fixtures/live-interactive-2026-09-29.json built from the real reports
